Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Uniparts India Limited reported a 27% year-on-year increase in revenue and 55% EBITDA growth for Q1 FY27, driven by strong performance in the construction equipment segment. Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule, while first customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3 of this year. Management highlighted strong operating cash generation, bringing the net cash balance to approximately INR190 crores. Management expects full-year FY27 revenue growth to exceed FY26 growth by a couple of percentage points. Uniparts India reported Q1 FY27 total income of INR 3,552 million, reflecting a 27% year-on-year growth, with EBITDA and PAT increasing by 55% and 64% year-on-year respectively.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 growth to be higher by a couple of percentage points compared to FY26 growth.
guidance.quote: And keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q2 FY27 performance to be robust and in line with Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of maintaining a 20% EBITDA margin over the business cycle.
guidance.quote: We are also very confident of maintaining our 20% EBITDA margin over the cycle.

guidance.claim: Uniparts reported Q1 FY27 performance in line with quarter-on-quarter guidance and better than annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: North America small agriculture segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment segment momentum from the second half of calendar year 2025 continued into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: On the construction equipment, the momentum that started in the second half of calendar year 2025 has continued into Q1 of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural equipment segment conditions remain subdued across the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the large agricultural equipment, conditions remain subdued as has been widely acknowledged across the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture equipment segment in India continues to perform well due to government subsidies and rising adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket business accounted for around 12% of revenue in Q1 FY27 and remained flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the US and government spending in Europe are sustaining order visibility in construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Economic uncertainty has tempered consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment in Western small agriculture markets.
demand_outlook.quote: In Western markets, small ag growth remains more measured. Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

demand_outlook.claim: Unit volumes in small agriculture are showing signs of recovery after three years of declines.
demand_outlook.quote: That said, the bottom appears to be behind us; after three consecutive years of volume declines, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes, and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs indicate that CY2026 marks the cyclical bottom for large agriculture, with recovery expected through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the aftermarket segment to return to growth following a reduction in tariffs.
demand_outlook.quote: With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalise and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment in North America.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The European construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery.

demand_outlook.claim: The European small agriculture market is showing early signs of stabilization.
demand_outlook.quote: In Europe, the small agriculture market is showing early signs of stabilization after a prolonged period of softening.

demand_outlook.claim: The second half of FY27 is expected to be stronger than the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule without customer supply disruption.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3 of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during Q1 FY27 stood at INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Organic capex requirements are typically about 2.5% to 3.5% of total revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: I think overall, if you see, even after having done that, today, our capex requirements as a business are roughly about 2.5% to 3.5% of our total revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track with warehouse customer deliveries expected to begin in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 grew by 55% year-on-year to INR 90 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded an inventory gain of approximately INR 1 crore during Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: There has been a small inventory gain that you will see on the face of the financials, and that's roughly about INR1 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Management targets maintaining material costs in the range of 34% to 37%.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation exerted pressure on supply chains and input costs.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% for quarter 4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: The company has maintained conscious cost discipline through the year.
margins_costs.quote: Second, we have maintained conscious cost discipline through the year.

margins_costs.claim: The company has stated consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month new business order book stands at over INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Construction business contributed 45% of total revenue in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Ashutosh, you are right that in Q1 FY27, the business has really seen a good growth in the construction business, which is today 45% of our total revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash position stood at approximately INR 190 crores at the end of Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash balance was approximately INR 210 crores prior to declaring a special dividend of INR 101 crores in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Just to put this in context, when we declared the special dividend of INR101 crores in October of '25, our cash balance was approximately INR210 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to evaluate acquisition opportunities to accelerate its strategy.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash generated during Q1 FY27 was INR 44 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts maintained a net cash position of INR 190 crore at the end of Q1.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts declared a special dividend of INR 101 crore in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To put this in context: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has exerted pressure on supply chains and input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchases in the aftermarket.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: One of the facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident in the finishing shop towards the end of quarter 3.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty in March.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3 of this year.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the fabrication vertical to become a meaningful business line within 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: Management is confident in delivering a 20% plus EBITDA margin over the business cycle.
management_commitments.quote: We, actually are confident that 20% plus is what we will deliver.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the rebuilding effort of the Ludhiana facility is well underway and normal operations are expected to return on schedule.
management_commitments.quote: And in parallel, the rebuilding effort is well underway. The incident is fully covered under our insurance policy and the claim was filed during the quarter. We expect normal operations to return on schedule.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
